description: This file defines the AutolockService class, responsible for managing automatic locking of the application based on user inactivity and focus state. It handles polling for focus changes, setting/getting auto-lock intervals, and triggering application lock procedures.
external_methods: ApplicationInterface (methods: isLaunched, addEventObserver, hasPasscode, lock, setValue, getValue, removeValue)

classes.name: AutolockService
classes.description: A service class that manages automatic locking behavior based on app focus and user inactivity.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Starts the polling process when the application launches.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up timers and event subscriptions when the service is de-initialized.

methods.name: addAppEventObserverAfterSubclassesFinishConstructing
methods.description: Sets up an observer for application events after construction is complete.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Registers event listeners to react to application launch events.

methods.name: lockApplication
methods.description: Locks the application if a passcode is set.

methods.name: setAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Stores the auto-lock interval preference in application storage.

methods.name: getAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the current auto-lock interval setting.

methods.name: deleteAutolockPreference
methods.description: Removes the auto-lock interval setting and cancels any auto-lock timers.

methods.name: beginPolling
methods.description: Periodically checks app focus and lock state to determine when to lock the app.

methods.name: getAutoLockIntervalOptions
methods.description: Provides predefined options for auto-lock intervals.

methods.name: documentVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in document visibility (focused or blurred).

methods.name: beginAutoLockTimer
methods.description: Starts the auto-lock countdown based on configured interval.
